title: 2mi->Broadway | Pool | Speakeasy Historic 1BR Flat
description:
History Meets Luxury in This One-of-a-Kind Nashville Stay!

This main-floor condo, set in a late Civil-War-era tobacco warehouse, blends vintage and industrial style. With soaring ceilings, original cedar beams, and graffiti-covered brick walls, it offers a luxe experience with a nod to the building's rich history. The perfect mix of old-world charm and modern comfort—truly a unique Nashville stay! 

1.6mi to Broadway
2.2mi to Bridgestone Arena
2.6mi to Nissan Stadium

Follow us on IG! @peakhost

The space
🎉 Perfect for Two (or a Few) – Your Nashville Hideaway!

This stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bath flat is the ideal home base for a couple’s getaway, a small group of friends, or even a solo escape. With a comfy queen bed, a plush pull-out sofa, and cozy design touches, you’ll have everything you need to relax between Nashville adventures. The fully stocked kitchen makes dining in easy, while the living room is the perfect spot to unwind after a night on Broadway. And yes—there’s a washer and dryer to keep things fresh during your stay!

Shared Building Perks:

✨ Top-Floor Balcony: On the 4th floor, just down the hall, furnished and ready for your morning coffee or evening wind-down.

💦 Plunge Pool: Take a refreshing dip in the shared patio’s dipping pool—it’s relaxation, not laps.

🍹 Grills & Self-Serve Bar: Fire up dinner on the grill or shake up a cocktail at the communal bar area by the pool.

Prime Location: Nestled in a hip, industrial-meets-residential pocket of Nashville, you’re only 2 miles from the downtown buzz and minutes from the city’s hottest neighborhoods. From craft cocktails and coffee shops to music venues and boutiques, everything you’ll want is just around the corner.

Guest access
Convenience & Accessibility? We’ve Got You Covered! 🚗✨

Free Parking: Enjoy hassle-free parking inside the gated property of The 1865—secure and super convenient!

Easy Access: Both the building and condo feature keypad entry for a seamless check-in experience. Plus, an elevator whisks you up to the top floor with ease.

Other things to note
A Quick Note About Trains 🚂:
While you won’t hear road noise at the condo, there is a train track next to the building. It’s not a high-speed line, but you may hear some noise as trains pass by. To keep things cozy and quiet, we’ve got you covered with earplugs for a peaceful night’s sleep!
